statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); ∀ (M N Q : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℂ), let S (t : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico M (M + N), c k * E ((k : ℝ) * t); (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q, ∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), ‖S ((a : ℝ) / q)‖ ^ 2) ≤ (Real.pi * (N : ℝ) + (Q : ℝ) ^ 2) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico M (M + N), ‖c k‖ ^ 2

plain_statement.en: For N consecutive frequencies, the sum of |S(a/q)|² over all reduced residues with q ≤ Q is at most (πN + Q²) times the squared coefficient norm.
plain_statement.zh: 对 N 个连续频率，在所有分母 q ≤ Q 的既约剩余类上求和，|S(a/q)|² 的总和不超过系数模平方和的 πN + Q² 倍。

brief.en: Center the frequencies and apply the midpoint bound on disjoint windows of length 1/Q². Parseval on a translated unit interval and Cauchy–Schwarz bound the derivative contribution by πN times the coefficient energy.
brief.zh: 将频率移至以零为中心的位置，在长度为 1/Q² 的不交窗口上应用中点估计。用平移后的单位区间上的帕塞瓦尔恒等式和柯西–施瓦茨不等式，将导数贡献控制在系数模平方和的 πN 倍以内。
